record.question: What applies when entering from another agency or continuing to Yosemite or Hoover?
record.reason: Stanislaus, Hoover/Bridgeport and Yosemite entry-agency rules and selected route contexts are represented. Leavitt Lake has no trailhead quota but overnight permits; Leavitt Meadows has quota. South-of-CA120 continuation/addendum wording differs between Hoover booking and NPS outside-origin guidance. Exact jurisdiction along divides, Yosemite-bound issuance logistics, PCT long-distance permits and unmodeled continuations still require agency confirmation.
